title: The Wishing Well
hook: Grandma's well had one rule: never drop anything down it after dark. I dropped a penny... and made a wish.
lines: My grandmother's farm had an old stone well, sealed under a heavy wooden lid.
She had one rule about it.
Never drop anything down that well after dark. And if something ever comes back up... don't touch it.
The summer I stayed with her, I broke that rule on my very first night.
I slipped a penny through a crack in the lid... and wished for someone to play with.
The next morning, there was a penny on my pillow. Cold... and wet.
Grandma went pale. She said, from now on, you stay inside after sunset.
So every night, I watched the well from my bedroom window.
On the last night of summer... the lid slid open.
Then something tapped on my window. Three soft taps.
And a voice, exactly like mine, whispered... let me in. I'm what you wished for.
Mom came to get me the next morning. She hugged us both... and she doesn't remember ever having just one kid.
